#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class CF1187G {
public:
    CF1187G() { }
    void run() {
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
        int n, m, k, c, d;
        cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
        vector<int> ii(k);
        for (int &x : ii) {
            cin >> x;
            x--; // zero-based index
        }

        vector<vector<int>> aa(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u, v;
            cin >> u >> v;
            u--; v--;
            aa[u].push_back(v);
            aa[v].push_back(u);
        }

        int t = n + k + 1;
        int n_ = n * t + 1;
        long long m_ = k + (long long)(m * 2 * k + n) * (t - 1);

        int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
        vector<vector<int>> aa_; // adjacency list for graph
        vector<int> pi, dd, bb;
        vector<int> cost;
        vector<int> cc;
        vector<int> uu, vv, uv;
        vector<int> qq;
        vector<bool> iq;

        auto init = [&]() {
            aa_.assign(n_, vector<int>());
            pi.assign(n_, INF);
            dd.assign(n_, 0);
            bb.assign(n_, 0);
            cost.assign(m_, 0);
            cc.assign(m_ * 2, 0);
            uu.assign(m_, 0);
            vv.assign(m_, 0);
            uv.assign(m_, 0);
            qq.clear();
            iq.assign(n_, false);
        };

        auto link = [&](int u, int v, int cap, int cos) {
            int h = (int)UU.size();
            uu.push_back(u);
            vv.push_back(v);
            uv.push_back(u ^ v);
            cost.push_back(cos);
            cc.push_back(cap);
            aa_[u].push_back(h);
            aa_[v].push_back(h);
        };

        // For min cut calculation
        int nq = 1 << 20;
        int head = 0, cnt = 0;

        auto enqueue = [&](int v) {
            if (iq[v]) return;
            if ((int)qq.size() == nq) {
                // extend qq if needed
                // In C++, just use vector push_back
            }
            qq.push_back(v);
            iq[v] = true;
        };

        auto dequeue = [&]() {
            int u = qq[head];
            head++;
            iq[u] = false;
            return u;
        };

        auto spfa = [&](int s, int t) {
            fill(pi.begin(), pi.end(), INF);
            pi[s] = 0;
            head = 0; cnt = 0;
            enqueue(s);
            while (cnt > 0 || head < (int)qq.size()) {
                int u = dequeue();
                int d = dd[u] + 1;
                for (int h_ : aa_[u]) {
                    if (cc[h_] > 0) {
                        int h = h_ >> 1;
                        int p = pi[u] + (((h_ & 1) == 0) ? cost[h] : -cost[h]);
                        int v = u ^ uv[h];
                        if (pi[v] > p || (pi[v] == p && dd[v] > d)) {
                            pi[v] = p;
                            dd[v] = d;
                            bb[v] = h_;
                            enqueue(v);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return pi[t] != INF;
        };

        auto push = [&](int s, int t) {
            int c = INT_MAX;
            for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
                h = (int)bb[u];
                h_ = h;
                c = std::min(c, cc[h_]);
            }
            for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
                h = (int)bb[u];
                h_ = h;
                cc[h_] -= c;
                cc[h_ ^ 1] += c;
            }
        };

        auto push1 = [&](int s, int t) {
            for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
                h = (int)bb[u];
                h_ = h;
                cc[h_]--;
                cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
            }
        };

        auto edmonds_karp = [&](int s, int t) {
            while (spfa(s, t))
                push1(s, t);
            int c = 0;
            for (int h = 0; h < (int)uu.size(); h++)
                c += cost[h] * cc[(h << 1) + 1];
            return c;
        };

        init();

        // Build the flow network
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (int j : aa[i]) {
                    int v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                int v = u + 1;
                link(u, v, k, (i == 0) ? 0 : c);
            }
        }

        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++) {
            int sink_node = n_ - 1;
            int source_node = ii[h] * t + 0;
            link(sink_node, source_node, 1, 0);
        }

        // Run max flow
        int flow = edmonds_karp(n_ - 1, 0 * t + t - 1);
        cout << flow << "\n";
    }
};

    CF1187G solution;
    solution.run();
